scope: Actual ClipMarks desktop JAVA2D workflow at recorded source hashes; core and distribution acceptance remain pending.

observations.baseline: Dense diagonal segments stop at the outer rectangle and concave notch; no segment bridges the excluded notch.
observations.sparse: Wider spacing preserves the same clipping boundary.
observations.shallow-notch: Moving the notch floor reveals additional retained hatching above the smaller exclusion.
observations.supplied-strokes: The independent zigzag source is split at the notch while preserving separated interior pieces.
observations.recolored: Source-based alternating colors identify both pieces of a split source consistently.
observations.endpoints-hidden: Endpoint markers disappear while clipped strokes remain.
observations.overlay: Faint original strokes expose the removed outside portions; colored output still respects the region.

verified: Source hashes were stable across the native run; current compiled artifacts and all PNG hashes match the recorded evidence.

Restored spacing, restored notch and reset match baseline pixels; cached save and appearance-only geometry reuse passed.
limits: Mathematical centerline clipping; stroke widths and endpoint markers can extend past boundaries.
